items.exampleEn: My sister and I have the same shoes.
items.exampleZh: 我和姊姊有一樣的鞋子。

items.exampleEn: I walk my dog every morning.
You must be quiet in the library.
items.exampleZh: 在圖書館裡你必須保持安靜。

items.sentenceEn: Each student must bring a pen.
items.sentenceZh: 每個學生都必須帶一枝筆。

items.audioEn: Where is my phone? It was here before dinner.
items.audioZh: 我的手機在哪裡？晚餐前還在這裡。

items.sentenceEn: We go to the same cafe every day.
items.sentenceZh: 我們每天去同一家咖啡店。

items.sentenceEn: The TV is off, so the room is quiet.
items.sentenceZh: 電視關著，所以房間很安靜。

items.stemEn: You ____ stop at a red light.
items.stemZh: 遇到紅燈你必須停下來。

items.stemEn: I brush my teeth ____ I go to bed.

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, my friends and I meet at the same place. Before lunch, we play basketball. Each of us brings some water. Today, Leo asks, "Where is the ball?" We find it under a car. Then we play again.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，我和朋友們都在同一個地方碰面。午餐前我們打籃球，每個人都會帶一些水。今天 Leo 問：「球在哪裡？」我們在一台車底下找到它，然後又繼續打球。

questions.questionZh: 他們每個星期六午餐前做什麼？

rubricZh: 「每天早上」用 every morning，放句首或句尾都可以
習慣性的事用現在簡單式

items.promptZh: 我們必須在星期五前完成這份工作。
referenceEn: We must finish this work by Friday.
We must finish this work before Friday.
rubricZh: must 後面接動詞原形（例如 must finish）；寫 have to finish 也正確
「在星期五前」可寫，例如 by Friday、before Friday 等
